TORGID

The National Weather Service in Hastings has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
West central Greeley County in central Nebraska...
Northeastern Valley County in central Nebraska...

* Until 915 PM CDT.

* At 847 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Fort Hartsuff State Park, or 8 miles north of Ord,
moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and hail up to two inches in diameter.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Elyria around 850 PM CDT.

Other locations in the path of this tornadic thunderstorm include
Ord.

events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by prior excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Harrison County in northern West Virginia...
Western Taylor County in northern West Virginia...

* WHEN...Until 100 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 934 PM EDT, emergency management reported numerous high water
issues across the warned area due to prior heavy rain. Flooding
is ongoing. Between 1 and 2.5 inches of rain fell earlier.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Clarksburg, Bridgeport, Shinnston, Stonewood, Anmoore,
Enterprise, Flemington, Meadland, Rosemont, McGee and Despard.
- This includes the following highways...
Interstate 79 between mile markers 117 and 128. Route 50 in West
Virginia between mile markers 81 and 82.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
